- Change 3 (store=true default for new paid-tier projects, effective 2026-10-26): nothing breaks, and I left it alone. Whether to send store=false is a privacy decision for the team.
- Changes 4 and 5 (2.5-flash and 2.5-pro reroute on 2026-12-01): no call site uses either model, and none sets thinkingBudget, so I closed both. The target gemini-2.5-flash-lite is not deprecated. Sampling params such as temperature remain valid on it.

> In SDK releases from this version on, clients default to enabling an additional checksum on all Put calls and enabling validation on Get calls.
